question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"upholding."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The reason for using **"upholding"** in the blank is to convey the idea that civil servants are actively involved in maintaining or supporting democratic values and promoting the public good.
 
• **"Upholding"** in this context suggests that civil servants have a responsibility to ensure the continued existence and adherence to democratic principles and to actively contribute to the well-being of the public.
 
• It implies a proactive and supportive role in preserving democratic values and working towards the betterment of society. (लोकतांत्रिक मूल्यों के संरक्षण और समाज की बेहतरी की दिशा में काम करने में सक्रिय और सहायक भूमिका)
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct paragraph:

......Once they are appointed, civil servants are expected to abide by a code of conduct that emphasises impartiality, integrity and efficiency__ in carrying out their duties. Despite the challenges and demands of civil service work, it can be a highly rewarding career path, providing opportunities to make a positive impact on society and improve the lives of citizens. Whether working in a local, state or federal government agency, civil servants play a vital role in __**upholding**__ democratic values and promoting the public good.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 
• **Mimicking: **to copy somebody’s behaviour, movements, voice, etc. in an amusing way. (मज़ाक़िया ढंग से दूसरों की नक़ल उतारना)
 
• **Lacking: **not having enough of something. (जिसमें किसी बात की कमी हो, किसी बात में कम या न्‍यून)
 
• **Contextualizing: **place or study in context. (संदर्भ में स्थान या अध्ययन करना)
